title: Legesher review bundle
description: One completed review sitting, in the canonical wire shape every intake lane shares (CORE-1688; contract from the CORE-1538 intake architecture, section 4). The canonical-JSON bytes of this document mint the session uid, so the shape is append-only: fields may be ADDED in a later bundle_version, never changed or removed within one. 1.1 adds the pull-request source (source.kind 'github_pull_request' and source.path) and locale_commentary; a 1.0 bundle may use neither, so no 1.0 session uid moves. The bundle is a PUBLIC artifact: no email address, no private contact detail, ever — contact rides the private channel (CORE-1568) and only contact_captured (a boolean) is asserted here.

kit_version.description: The review-kit build the reviewer saw, or the issue-form format tag for Stage-0 imports (e.g. 'issue-form/language_pack_review@v1').

locale.description: BCP 47 tag in canonical case (ar, zh-Hans, ar-EG). The database CHECK on locales.tag is the authority; this pattern is the wire-level floor.

programming_language.description: PL scope of the sitting, or null for locale-wide (required null for style_profile — enforced by the importer and the DB CHECK).

source_key.description: The private natural key (GitHub username / portal account id). Feeds the salted contributor_id mint (CORE-1502); never published.

claimed_rung.description: Self-declared. Recorded, not verified — verification moves rungs, not sessions.

consent.description: Consent rides every submission (decision 2026-08-11). OPTIONAL at the wire level only because the Stage-0 issue form predates the notice: a submission without it still ingests as evidence but mints NO identity row.

consent_version.description: The CONTRIBUTOR_PRIVACY.md version the contributor agreed to (e.g. '1.0'). Recorded on contributor_identities at identity minting.

credit_text.description: Display name; required by the importer when credit_preference is 'name', ignored otherwise.

contact_captured.description: The contributor asserts their contact email reached the PRIVATE channel (CORE-1568). The address itself is NEVER in this file.

research_use.description: Contribution DATA (terms, endorsements, tags, expansions, published commentary — never identity or private durations) may appear in research datasets and publications.

blind.description: The reviewer's own suggestion, offered BEFORE candidates were shown. Becomes an option (if new) plus an endorsement, elicited='blind'.

ranking.description: Preference order over ENDORSED surface forms only (ranking ⊆ endorsements — bundle-level validation error otherwise; the DB trigger is the floor).

expansion.description: The phrase layer (elif-class concepts): the expanded phrase behind the contracted identifier the option carries.

for.description: The endorsed surface form the expansion attaches to.

locale_commentary.description: Locale-wide observations not keyed to one concept (bundle 1.1: the review template's Notes for Future Updates). Recorded as concept_commentary with no concept.

started_at.description: Client-reported ISO-8601; advisory evidence. Also the timestamp the withdrawal-tombstone importer rule compares (a missing value is treated as POSTDATING any withdrawal — conservative by design).

durations_ms.description: Per-concept durations. Brigading forensics only; never exported.

source.description: Where a maintainer-imported bundle came from, when it was not submitted as a bundle file directly (the Stage-0 issue lane, or a review file from a merged pull request). Part of the canonical bytes, so the same issue, or the same file from the same pull request, always re-mints the same session uid.

created_at.description: GitHub-attested creation time; used as started_at for the withdrawal rule.

path.description: The review file's path in the repository the pull request merged into (bundle 1.1).
